name: Hyatt
outlook:
What Hyatt says to expect

  • Full year 2026: comparable RevPAR growthComparable system-wide hotels RevPAR growth is projected to be between 5.0% and 5.5%, compared to the full year 2025
  • Full year 2026: net incomeNet income attributable to Hyatt Hotels Corporation is projected to be between $240 million and $310 million
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA is projected to be between $1,170 million and $1,200 million, an increase of 14% to 17%, compared to the full year 2025, after adjusting for the period of ownership of hotels acquired as part of the Playa Hotels Acquisition and assets sold in 2025
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
